title: NOTICE - ITC-2163-2026 Registration - updation of Whatsapp enabled Mobile Number by Advocate
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 06/10/2026 Sd/-

FULL TEXT:
NOTICE
No.ITC/2169/2026
It is hereby notified for the information of all Learned Advocates that under the
directions of Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justice, the High Court of Gujarat is
going to launch an automated WhatsApp Messaging Service. In the initial
pilot phase, this facility is introduced for direct, advocate-specific Daily
Cause-List delivery via WhatsApp.
To ensure seamless receipt of advocate-specific daily cause-lists and upcoming
WhatsApp eService, Learned Advocates, whose mobile number with whatsapp
facility is not registered with the High Court, are requested to register or
update their active WhatsApp mobile number in the High Court of Gujarat.
The mobile number can be updated by sending an email on
hcourt-ahmd-guj@nic.in with a scanned copy of Sanad, with following details:
Advocate Name:
Advocate Code:
Email ID:
New Mobile number:
Bar Council enrolment No.: G/____________/________
Attachment: Copy of Sanad
By Order,
Date: 06/10/2026 Sd/-
I/c. Registrar (SCMS & ICT)
